subject.title: fix(session): clear stale fallback model state on reset

question: Should legacy source-less overrides with a differing selected/active fallback notice be treated as automatic fallback state and cleared on reset/cron rollover?
rationale: This is an upgrade-compatibility policy choice for persisted sessions: the inferred provenance determines whether an existing user's override survives a reset.

options.title: Adopt the fallback-notice recovery rule
options.body: Define the selected-versus-active fallback notice as sufficient legacy auto-fallback provenance, then rebase and validate the rule against current main.

options.title: Preserve ambiguous legacy overrides
options.body: Keep all source-less overrides unless explicit fallback-origin metadata exists, avoiding any chance of clearing an intentional legacy user selection.

recommendation.title: Adopt the fallback-notice recovery rule
recommendation.body: Define the selected-versus-active fallback notice as sufficient legacy auto-fallback provenance, then rebase and validate the rule against current main.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work owns the adjacent recovered-auto-fallback provenance contract.
